title: [CON2-16] DM admission host responses are unspecified
description: Review finding CON2-16: DM admission host responses are unspecified (lens CON2). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:153-158; spec/03-spaces.md:313. Fix: §3.4 Responses says "Every other response is the record's encoded typed payload envelope with `sig` present", which the DM record (no `sig`) cannot satisfy, and the `PUT .../members` result is undefined. In §4.6 add: GET returns the encoded envelope without `sig` as `application/cbor`; PUT takes the encoded `DMMembers` envelope, returns 204, and otherwise 401/403/404/429 as §3.4, plus 409 for a `ts` not later than the current list's. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
